title: Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting under Moving-Solid Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.16167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose the task of Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting: predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of a future dense 3D liquid velocity field conditioned on how a solid object moves through it. This task provides an upstream physical forecasting primitive for systems that need to reason about motion-conditioned liquid response, including robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, and rigid-fluid video generation. Existing works have made efforts in predicting flow around static or prescribed solid geometries and synthesizing visually plausible fluid motion. Yet these approaches provide limited coverage for interactive liquid dynamics, as they are not capable of forecasting how a moving solid induces a future full-domain liquid response. translated_title: 移动固体交互下的交互式4D体积液体预测
translated_abstract: 我们提出了交互式4D体积液体预测这一任务：以固体物体穿过液体的运动方式为条件，预测未来稠密3D液体速度场的时空演化。该任务为需要推理运动条件下液体响应的系统提供了上游物理预测基元，包括机器人液体操作、数字孪生以及刚体-流体视频生成。现有工作已致力于预测静态或预设固体几何周围的流动，并合成视觉上合理的流体运动。然而，这些方法对交互式液体动力学的覆盖能力有限，因为它们无法预测移动固体如何诱发未来的全域液体响应。在这一预测场景中，流体动力学效应集中在不断演化的液-固界面附近，而预测目标则是全局性的时空展开。为应对这一挑战……
tldr: 该论文提出“交互式4D体积液体预测”新任务，以固体在液体中的运动为条件预测稠密3D液体速度场的全局时空演化，为机器人液体操作、数字孪生和刚体-流体视频生成等应用提供上游物理预测基元。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the task of Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting, which predicts the global spatiotemporal evolution of a dense 3D liquid velocity field conditioned on a moving solid, providing an upstream physical forecasting primitive for robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, and rigid-fluid video generation.
